# Run chatty tests. Assert on CONT lines.
! go test chatty_test.go -v

# Sanity check that output occurs.
stdout -count=2 'this is sub-0'
stdout -count=2 'this is sub-1'
stdout -count=2 'this is sub-2'
stdout -count=1 'error from sub-0'
stdout -count=1 'error from sub-1'
stdout -count=1 'error from sub-2'

# A subtest runs inside the t.Run that starts it, even in this fork, so each is
# announced with RUN. One that took itself parallel would resume with CONT or
# NAME. The counts above already hold every log and error line to one
# appearance.
stdout '=== (RUN|CONT|NAME) +TestChatty/sub-0'
stdout '=== (RUN|CONT|NAME) +TestChatty/sub-1'
stdout '=== (RUN|CONT|NAME) +TestChatty/sub-2'

-- chatty_test.go --
package chatty_test

import (
	"testing"
	"fmt"
)

func TestChatty(t *testing.T) {
    for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
        t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("sub-%d", i), func(t *testing.T) {
            for j := 0; j < 2; j++ {
                t.Logf("this is sub-%d", i)
            }
            t.Errorf("error from sub-%d", i)
        })
    }
}
